summary: Nomadar Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 13, 2026 Equity Purchase Agreement under which its wholly owned subsidiary, Fox Soccer Holding Company LLC, will acquire 100% of Fox Soccer Academy LLC (NY), Fox Sports Academy of the Carolinas LLC, Fox Soccer Academy LTD (UK), and Fox Soccer Academy Austria from seven named sellers. Immediately after acquisition, sellers will contribute back equity equal to 49% of the Fox Companies, leaving Nomadar with 51% and sellers 49%. Closing is subject to customary conditions, governmental consents, no MAE, and employment agreements; either party may terminate if closing has not occurred within 60 days. No purchase price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch regulatory consents and the 60-day outside date.
